purpose: Define governed delivery of static assets, generated pages and data projections without allowing web-server delivery mechanics to redefine canonical source ownership or classification.

topics.name: Expose Web Resource Delivery
topics.purpose: Define governed delivery of static assets, generated pages and data projections without allowing web-server delivery mechanics to redefine canonical source ownership or classification.

semantics.resource_rule: Delivered resource resolves an exact logical source/asset/page/projection identity.
semantics.classification_rule: Delivery obeys applicable source classification and AccessCore/DWH governance.
semantics.cache_rule: HTTP/browser/proxy cache is a delivery optimization only.
semantics.etag_rule: ETag/revision evidence is explicit where used.
semantics.source_rule: Delivered copy is not the canonical source merely because it is cached.
semantics.authority_rule: Successful delivery grants no mutation authority.

invariants.rule: UI visibility, navigation, placement, styling, selection, focus and visual adjacency never create semantic ownership, resource identity or execution authority.
Effect-capable UI actions create explicit candidate/request data and must cross canonical validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before effects occur.

hard_gates.condition: browser cache becomes source of truth
mime sniffing changes semantic type silently

references.purpose: Delivery caching follows non-authoritative cache principles.
